I am a 4th year PhD candidate working with [Bill Hoffmann](https://cals.ncsu.edu/plant-and-microbial-biology/people/wahoffma/){target="_blank"} at North Carolina State University. My [research](index.qmd){target="_blank"} focuses on population-, community-, and ecosystem-level responses to variation in stand density and canopy composition in longleaf pine ecosystems. 

In addition to my research, I am  
- Treasurer of the Plant Biology Graduate Student Association
- a [Grad Peer Mentor](https://peermentors.cals.ncsu.edu/){target="_blank"} through the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences
- a studio potter and ceramics teacher at the NC State Craft Center
